headline: EFC (I) Limited Board approves Rights Equity Issue of ₹159.94 crore
sum: EFC (I) Limited's Board approved a rights issue of 1,06,62,786 equity shares at ₹150 per share, aggregating ₹159.94 crore. The issuance was formally notified via BSE/NSE regulatory filing on 1 May 2026.
implication: Rights issues trigger shareholder approval, stock exchange listing compliance, and FEMA reporting under Schedule 1 of the Liberalised Remittance Scheme if any overseas shareholder participation is entertained; structure also engages preferential allotment disclosure norms and ex-date mechanics.
detail: The Board resolution dated 1 May 2026 approved issuance of 1,06,62,786 Rights Equity Shares at an issue price of ₹150 per share, for a total consideration of ₹159,94,17,900. The rights issue mechanism allows existing shareholders to subscribe proportionally to their holdings before public allotment. Stock exchange notification via NSE archives confirms formal Board approval and regulatory filing. Shareholder ratification and Credit Rating Agency lodgement of the offer document are likely next steps prior to ex-date announcement.
